additional_info.subject: RE: ID0435919-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / P0 312569868/04] Outlet Issue CRM:02889000160
additional_info.body:
Dear Bastien Bonhomme,
I hope this message finds you well.
We wanted to inform you that
Outlet 1 was previously out of order due to a coil being stuck
. The issue has since been resolved and the outlet is now functioning normally.
Additionally, there was a
temporary communication issue with SECC
, which affected the outlets at another time. This has also been addressed and is no longer impacting operations.
If you observe any similar behavior again, please don’t hesitate to reach out. We will escalate the matter to our regional team for further investigation and a possible site visit.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -Ankita

additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
As per our recent log analysis, it has been observed that the QA9-10 contactor is stuck in the "On" state. This malfunction is leading to operational issues when Outlet2 is engaged and an attempt is made to activate Outlet1.
To resolve this, we request you to urgently check the QA9-10 conne tions and replace the QA9-10 contactors as necessary.
MLFB NO.
8EM5903-0AA00-7AA8-QA9-10
